---
title: "蔬菜認字遊戲"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    page-layout: full
---

~~~~{=html}
<style>
body {
  background: #fff8ef;
  font-family: Arial, "Microsoft JhengHei", "PingFang HK", sans-serif;
}

.game-container {
  max-width: 950px;
  margin: 25px auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.start-page {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 70px 35px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  margin-top: 80px;
}

.start-title {
  font-size: 68px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 45px;
}

.start-button {
  font-size: 46px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 25px 80px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: #ffb347;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.start-button:hover {
  background: #ffa726;
}

.title {
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: #333;
}

.progress {
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 30px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.image-box {
  height: 420px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.image-box img {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 420px;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: 20px;
}

.choices {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.choice-button {
  font-size: 42px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 25px 15px;
  border: 4px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: #f8f8f8;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 110px;
}

.choice-button:hover {
  background: #fff0d6;
}

.choice-button.correct {
  background: #92e6a7;
  border-color: #2b9348;
  color: #064b1c;
}

.choice-button.wrong {
  background: #ffadad;
  border-color: #d00000;
  color: #7b0000;
}

.choice-button.disabled {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.next-button {
  display: none;
  font-size: 34px;
  padding: 18px 55px;
  margin-top: 30px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #ffb347;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.next-button:hover {
  background: #ffa726;
}

.result-page {
  display: none;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 45px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  margin-top: 80px;
}

.result-title {
  font-size: 56px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.result-score {
  font-size: 48px;
  color: #2b9348;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.restart-button {
  font-size: 36px;
  padding: 20px 55px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #ffb347;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.restart-button:hover {
  background: #ffa726;
}

.feedback {
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-top: 20px;
  min-height: 50px;
}

.feedback.correct-text {
  color: #2b9348;
}

.feedback.wrong-text {
  color: #d00000;
}
</style>
~~~~

~~~~{=html}
<div class="game-container">

  <div class="start-page" id="start-page">
    <div class="start-title">準備好未？</div>
    <button class="start-button" type="button" onclick="startGame()">開始</button>
  </div>

  <div id="game-page" style="display: none;">
    <div class="title">蔬菜認字遊戲</div>
    <div class="progress" id="progress">第 1 / 10 題</div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="image-box">
        <img id="veg-image" src="" alt="蔬菜圖片">
      </div>

      <div class="choices" id="choices"></div>

      <div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>

      <button class="next-button" id="next-button" type="button" onclick="nextQuestion()">下一題</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="result-page" id="result-page">
    <div class="result-title">完成！</div>
    <div class="result-score" id="result-score"></div>
    <button class="restart-button" type="button" onclick="restartGame()">再玩一次</button>
  </div>

</div>
~~~~

~~~~{=html}
<script>
const vegetables = [
  {
    word: "菜心",
    english: "Choy sum",
    image: "images/choi-sum.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "芥蘭",
    english: "Chinese kale",
    image: "images/gai-lan.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "通菜",
    english: "Water spinach",
    image: "images/water-spinach.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "菠菜",
    english: "Spinach",
    image: "images/spinach.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "西蘭花",
    english: "Broccoli",
    image: "images/broccoli.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "椰菜花",
    english: "Cauliflower",
    image: "images/cauliflower.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "生菜",
    english: "Lettuce",
    image: "images/lettuce.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "蕃茄",
    english: "Tomato",
    image: "images/tomato.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "紅蘿蔔",
    english: "Carrot",
    image: "images/carrot.jpg"
  },
  {
    word: "薯仔",
    english: "Potato",
    image: "images/potato.jpg"
  }
];

let questions = [];
let currentQuestionIndex = 0;
let score = 0;
let answered = false;

function shuffleArray(array) {
  const newArray = array.slice();

  for (let i = newArray.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const temp = newArray[i];
    newArray[i] = newArray[j];
    newArray[j] = temp;
  }

  return newArray;
}

function getRandomChoices(correctVeg) {
  const wrongChoices = vegetables
    .filter(function(v) {
      return v.word !== correctVeg.word;
    })
    .map(function(v) {
      return v.word;
    });

  const selectedWrongChoices = shuffleArray(wrongChoices).slice(0, 3);
  const allChoices = shuffleArray([correctVeg.word].concat(selectedWrongChoices));

  return allChoices;
}

function startGame() {
  questions = shuffleArray(vegetables);
  currentQuestionIndex = 0;
  score = 0;
  answered = false;

  document.getElementById("start-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("game-page").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("result-page").style.display = "none";

  showQuestion();
}

function showQuestion() {
  answered = false;

  const currentVeg = questions[currentQuestionIndex];

  document.getElementById("veg-image").src = currentVeg.image;
  document.getElementById("veg-image").alt = currentVeg.word;

  document.getElementById("progress").textContent =
    "第 " + (currentQuestionIndex + 1) + " / " + questions.length + " 題";

  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback";

  document.getElementById("next-button").style.display = "none";

  const choices = getRandomChoices(currentVeg);
  const choicesDiv = document.getElementById("choices");
  choicesDiv.innerHTML = "";

  choices.forEach(function(choice) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.className = "choice-button";
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = choice;

    button.onclick = function() {
      checkAnswer(button, choice, currentVeg.word);
    };

    choicesDiv.appendChild(button);
  });
}

function checkAnswer(button, selectedChoice, correctAnswer) {
  if (answered) {
    return;
  }

  answered = true;

  const allButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".choice-button");

  allButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.classList.add("disabled");

    if (btn.textContent === correctAnswer) {
      btn.classList.add("correct");
    }
  });

  if (selectedChoice === correctAnswer) {
    button.classList.add("correct");
    score = score + 1;

    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "答對了！";
    document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback correct-text";
  } else {
    button.classList.add("wrong");

    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent =
      "不是，這是「" + correctAnswer + "」";

    document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback wrong-text";
  }

  document.getElementById("next-button").style.display = "inline-block";
}

function nextQuestion() {
  currentQuestionIndex = currentQuestionIndex + 1;

  if (currentQuestionIndex >= questions.length) {
    showResult();
  } else {
    showQuestion();
  }
}

function showResult() {
  document.getElementById("start-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("game-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("result-page").style.display = "block";

  document.getElementById("result-score").textContent =
    "答對 " + score + " / " + questions.length + " 題";
}

function restartGame() {
  document.getElementById("start-page").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("game-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("result-page").style.display = "none";
}
</script>
~~~~
